answer: Seals are sold, not given: each epoch the protocol auctions 200 attestation seals at one uniform price, and every winning seal burns it. Honest bids clear near 20 POA. A farm taking 100 seals must bid for half the supply, lifting the price on all its own wins; at 60% demand a seal clears at 12 times the floor, so its hundredth clone burns 1,200 POA while an honest key pays 20. A nectar receipt sets one bid price per key; two bids from one dune of shared funding are voided and forfeit. The pulse publishes the cleared price, so peers see whose demand priced itself out.
